# New renderings — iliad-143 (Iliad 23.1–98)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Μυρμιδόνες ταχύπωλοι (23.6, vocative) | "Myrmidons swift-colted" | "Myrmidons with your swift colts" | "swift-horsed"; follows the table's ταχύπωλος row (4.232) for the people |
| ἐΰτριχες ἵπποι (ἐΰτριχας ἵππους, 23.13) | "well-maned horses" | "well-maned horses" | "fine-maned", "fair-maned" (reserved for καλλίτριχες), "thick-maned" |
| χαῖρέ μοι ὦ Πάτροκλε (23.19, to the dead) | "Be glad, Patroclus" | "Be glad, Patroclus" | "Rejoice", "Hail", "Farewell"; kept distinct from χαῖρε, ξεῖνε "Welcome, stranger" |
| μήστωρα φόβοιο (23.16, no κρατερόν) | "master of flight" | "a master of flight" | "counsellor of rout"; follows the table's κρατερὸν μήστωρα φόβοιο (12.39) |
| βόες ἀργοί (23.30) | "white oxen" | "white oxen" | "swift oxen" (the table's κύνες ἀργοί "swift dogs" is for hunting dogs; ἀργός is "gleaming white" or "swift", disputed) |
| κοτυλήρυτον (αἷμα, 23.34) | "in cupfuls" | "ran in cupfuls" | "cup-drawn", "ladled"; formation uncertain (ἀρύω "draw" or ῥέω "flow"), the note says so |
| ἀνδροφόνους χεῖρας (23.18) | "man-slaying hands" | "man-slaying hands" | unchanged, from the shipped iliad-119 unit |
| κὴρ … στυγερή (23.78) | "hateful death-spirit" | "the hateful death-spirit" | "doom", "fate" (reserved for μοῖρα, πότμος); follows the table's κὴρ εἴδεται εἶναι (1.228) |
| ὀλοὸς γόος (ὀλοοῖο … γόοιο, 23.10, 23.98) | "baneful lament" | "baneful lament" | "deadly lament", "ruinous" (reserved for οὐλόμενος); follows the table's ὀλοοῖο "baneful" (3.133) |
| ἀκάματον πῦρ (23.52) | "untiring fire" | "the untiring fire" | table row (5.4, 20.123), unchanged |
| ἱππότα Πηλεύς (23.89) | "Peleus the horseman" | "Peleus the horseman" | "the knight", "charioteer"; follows the table's ἱππότα "horseman" |
| ὕπνος νήδυμος … ἀμφιχυθείς (23.62–63) | "sweet, poured round him" | "sweet and poured all about him" | table's νήδυμος "sweet" (meaning not known), unchanged |
| ἀνδροκτασίης … λυγρῆς (23.86) | "grievous man-slaying" | "a grievous man-slaying" | "baneful", "slaughter"; follows the table's ἀνδροκτασίη "man-slaying" and λυγρός "grievous" |
| θεοῖς ἐπιείκελ’ Ἀχιλλεῦ (23.80) | "resembling the gods, Achilles" | "you who are like the gods" | the table's 22.279 row, unchanged |
| γέρας … θανόντων (23.9) | "the prize of the dead" | "the prize of honour that belongs to the dead" | none; follows the table's γέρας "prize" / "prize of honour" (16.457) |
| ἠθείη κεφαλή (23.94, vocative) | "honoured head" | "honoured head" | "dear head", "beloved"; ἠθεῖος "honoured, dear to one", of the ghost addressed |
| ἀμφιφορεύς (23.92) | "a golden amphora" | "the golden jar" | "two-handled vessel" (a gloss); the two-handled storage jar |
| λοετρά (23.44) | "washing-water" | "washing-water" | "warm baths" (the table's θερμὰ λοετρά 22.443 has the adjective and is for the heated bath being prepared); here the word stands alone for the water of washing itself, after the oath that he will not wash |
